responsibility: Provides the Android-specific overlay for Linux targets. It defines the __ANDROID__ builtin hook, specs that choose between plain Linux and Android command behavior, Android-specific cc1 defaults such as forcing Bionic and PIC, Android linker behavior for shared objects, and Android crt begin/end file selection. This file is the Linux/Android specialization layer used in conjunction with broader Linux and GNU-user configuration headers.
same_name_distinction: Within the linux-android same-name pair, this header implements the Android-specific overlay on top of Linux by defining builtins and specs that switch between Linux and Android behavior; linux-android.opt only declares the controlling options such as -mandroid and the internal tno-android selectors.
